fields.works: Bhāvārtha-dīpikā (on the Bhāgavatam); Subodhinī (on the Bhagavad-gītā); Ātma-prakāśa (on the Viṣṇu Purāṇa); Bāla-bodhinī (on the Sanatsujātīya); Vraja-vihāra-kāvya; verses in the Padyāvalī
fields.notes: Author of the Bhāvārtha-dīpikā on the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam (written between 1350 and 1450 CE), which Lord Caitanya approved; He told others to write in harmony with it, and Sanātana and Jīva Gosvāmī followed it (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Antya 7.129-131). An ekadaṇḍi sannyāsī of Kāśī, worshipper of Nṛsiṁha; his guru was Paramānanda. Upheld the eternity of the Lord, bhakti and the devotee against Kevalādvaita (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna, «Śrīdhara Svāmī»). Not Śrīdhara Brahmacārī of Gadādhara's branch.
